[[File:Stormtrooper_Grenadier.png|thumb|right|180px|A stormtrooper grenadier]]
'''Stormtrooper grenadiers''' were elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] specialized in the use of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].<ref name="Assault Team" />

==Equipment==
As their name suggests, stormtrooper grenadiers received special training in the use of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. Their main weapon was the [[SE-14 blaster pistol]], but they also used [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to kill multiple enemies and destroy vehicles.<ref name="Assault Team" />

The stormtrooper grenadiers' armor was basic [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], albeit slightly stronger and more durable. They also carried a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] that contained ammunition, as well as [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] products.<ref name="Assault Team" /> However, some instead wore [[Snowtrooper armor/Legends|similar armor]] to that of [[cold assault stormtrooper]]s, [[Vader's Special Force Trooper]]s, and to a certain extent [[Darth Vader's Security Force]]; they were armed with [[Plasma grenade/Legends|plasma grenades]] and used large alloy shields for protection. These grenadier troopers were deployed during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and later accompanied [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during his attempt to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="SuperEMP">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper grenadier first appeared in ''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', and was mentioned as "grenadier troopers" in the strategy guide ''[[Super Empire Strikes Back Official Game Secrets]]''.<ref name="SESBOFGS">''[[Super Empire Strikes Back Official Game Secrets]]''</ref> However, they were later identified in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
